mapper.sql: id, report_id AS reportId, parse_version AS parseVersion, active, report_type AS reportType, parse_confidence AS parseConfidence, status, request_key AS requestKey
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_parse_result (id, report_id, parse_version, active, report_type, parse_confidence, status, request_key, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{reportId}, #{parseVersion}, #{active}, #{reportType}, #{parseConfidence}, #{status}, #{requestKey}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE report_parse_result SET active = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT FROM report_parse_result WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND active = 1
SELECT FROM report_parse_result WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND request_key = #{requestKey}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(parse_version), 0) FROM report_parse_result WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
